hints.title: Filter Invalid Strings and Map to Bitmasks
hints.text: Discard any input string containing duplicate characters; represent remaining valid strings as bitmasks.

hints.title: Maintain Set of Valid Concatenated Masks
hints.text: Start with an empty mask 0; for each string mask, combine it with all compatible existing masks.

hints.title: Track Maximum Set Bit Count
hints.text: Return the maximum number of set bits across all successfully generated unique masks.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: length of array arr (at most 16)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: String concatenation and substring checks repeatedly allocate memory and incur O(2^N * L^2) overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bitmask operations allow single-cycle overlap verification with bitwise AND.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should discard intra-string duplicates upfront and evaluate mask bit counts.
